title: Product & Technical Lead: Learning Analytics & Student Support
summary: Leading the strategic product development and technical implementation of a wide £ programme of transformational features, enabling data-informed student success initiatives and experience platforms for student support, retention, and operational efficiency.

projects.title: Learning Analytics for Early Intervention
projects.body: Led the design and development of a data-informed learning analytics platform to identify at-risk students early in the semester. Created dashboards that allow faculty to visualise student learning data, identify trends, and support student success. Implemented an organisational-first student ambassador led call centre to enable peer-led support and signposting. Also designed and introduced the first version of a platform-wide Insights service and design to enable proactive calls to action.
projects.award: Vice-Chancellor's Award for Supporting a Great Student Experience 'Highly Commended'

projects.title: Student Support Enquiry & Case Management
projects.body: Leading the design and implementation of a fully integrated student support enquiry & case management system across the entire institution. A secure system for managing sensitive student support cases and wellbeing interventions, ensuring data privacy and compliance.

title: Digital Education Product Manager
summary: Building a first class student success platform for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry. Member of multiple faculty committees.

projects.title: PULSE Student Success Platform
projects.body: Led the design and implementation of a comprehensive student success platform for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry at Plymouth University, encompassing a wide range of modules to support the entire student journey from concept to launch. My role involved stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, UX/UI design, and managing the agile development process. The platform now serves 1,200+ students daily and has reduced administrative overhead by 30%.

projects.title: Content Adaptive Progress Testing
projects.body: Designed and implemented a sophisticated assessment platform delivering content-adaptive progress testing and topic mapping for medical students. Introduced an industry-first feedback system to enable longitudinal personalised learning feedback to medical students against the GMC topic map. Coinciding and enabling dynamic assessment of students based on past assessment performance.

projects.title: On-Clinic Dental Experience Assessment
projects.body: Digitised the assessment of clinical dental experience, replacing paper logs and enabling real-time progression tracking via a specialised mobile-friendly tool for recording and validating clinical experience in dental clinics. Providing process assurance for patient safety and enabling students to work towards their longitudinal GDC requirements. Also enabled capacity management to ensure patient availability for student needs and scheduling. Used across TBA clinical sites across the south-west of England.

projects.title: Competency Based Assessment
projects.body: System for tracking and verifying student competency across practical skills, enabling faculty to monitor progression and ensure students meet professional standards.

projects.title: Short Courses Platform
projects.body: A web-based platform handling booking, payment, and management of short professional development courses for continuing education.

extraProjects.title: Dynamic Assessments
extraProjects.body: Integration services connecting assessment platforms with student record systems, enabling real-time assessment data flow.

extraProjects.title: Academic Benchmarking
extraProjects.body: Developed a comparative analytics tool allowing faculty to benchmark cohort performance against national standards.

extraProjects.title: Wave Digital Assistant
extraProjects.body: AI chatbot for staff digital education queries in Moodle & student careers advice in the university app. Connects to live agents when needed.

title: Product Architect; Senior UX Designer
summary: Leading UX and product design, building campaign management and reporting tools for a cutting-edge AdTech platform.

projects.title: iotec Horizon Platform Interface
projects.body: Led the design and implementation of a self-service campaign management and reporting web interface, empowering clients to manage their own digital advertising campaigns. I led the entire product design lifecycle, from user research and wireframing to high-fidelity prototypes and front-end development support. The platform was fully internationalised for major European markets to enable strategic expansion, achieving an 80% reduction in campaign setup time and enabling the business to scale to 200+ clients.

projects.title: iotec Platform RESTful API
projects.body: Led the development of a RESTful API for the iotec Horizon Platform, enabling seamless integration with external systems and applications as well as a unified platform for developing new products and features internally.

title: Freelance Product Design & Development
summary: Designing, building, and implementing 0 → 1 products across multiple industries.

projects.title: BearForms
projects.body: A simple, offline, no-fuss data capture form app for iPhone, iPad, and Android. Design your form. Capture your responses. Export your data. Done. Designed, developed, and launched this multi-platform app from scratch using React Native, including UI/UX design and App Store deployment.

projects.title: Bento for iOS & Android
projects.body: A "Do Less" to-do list application based on the Bento methodology, designed for focus and mindful productivity. This project explores the intersection of digital utility and mental well-being, using a limited-choice interface to reduce cognitive load.
projects.award: Featured by Apple as a "New & Noteworthy" and a Top 5 Paid Productivity App in 30 different countries

projects.title: Investigate Invertebrates
projects.body: A companion iOS app for the Paignton Zoo exhibit, designed to educate and engage visitors, particularly younger audiences, with interactive content. The app utilized gamification to increase visitor dwell time and engagement with the exhibits.

projects.title: Local Government Digital Healthcare Initiative
projects.body: A project to digitize citizen services for local government, focusing on accessibility and digital service transformation.

extraProjects.title: Trifecta Workout
extraProjects.body: A beautiful and simply designed personal trainer app for iPhone, focusing on core workout principles. Built with Swift.

extraProjects.title: Soke
extraProjects.body: Branding and UI concept for a creative agency focused on clarity and impact.

extraProjects.title: Stories
extraProjects.body: A curated content aggregator app for your favourite topics. Built for iOS using Objective-C with API integrations.

extraProjects.title: Get Gear
extraProjects.body: A mobile and location-based marketplace concept for easily buying and selling gear.
